context_for_next_testing_agent: Batch 5 features fully tested: 1) Dark mode - ThemeContext with localStorage persistence (key: letsm_theme), CSS .dark class on html element with overrides in index.css. 2) Data export - 4 endpoints (/api/export/tasks, /reminders, /conversations, /all) return JSON with proper structure. Profile page has download buttons that create blob URLs. 3) Browser notifications - Section in Profile with permission request using native Notification API. 4) Watch Demo modal - Opens from landing page with 5-step walkthrough animation using framer-motion. 5) FloatingChat localStorage - Persists messages to letsm_guest_chat with 24h expiry, clear button works.
